about: Spike H1 profiles for quenching scripts/run_evals.py (--harnesses). Every invocation, agent and grader alike, goes through run.sh --agent, which mints a fresh Databricks token and runs agent.sh: one disposable container, only the case fixture mounted. The with arm invokes the suite's OpenCode command with the case prompt as its arguments. No profile carries a permission bypass; --auto arrives only through --extra-arg.
